title: Atlas Research Project Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a research project / Forschungsprojekt (projekte/*.md). ADR-0004: atlas.project/3 is a DIFFERENT entity than atlas.project/1|2 — those are legacy Publications and are migrated to atlas.publication/1 at startup. Carries the funded-project facts (Laufzeit, funder, Foerderkennzeichen, role), structured milestones (rendered as a timeline with next/overdue indication) and project-relevant literature refs (Paper cite keys; hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired). Work packages live in the Markdown body as headings with GFM checklists, not in the frontmatter.

status.description: Lifecycle planned → applied → active → finished, plus terminal rejected.

role.description: Own role in the project (e.g. PI, Mitarbeiter, Antragsteller).

refs.description: Project-relevant literature as Paper cite keys → join to the LocalBib library. Hanging refs are warnings, never auto-repaired.

milestones.description: Structured milestones — the UI renders a timeline with next/overdue indication.
